item.title: LEO FARRELL JOINS SCUNTHORPE UNITED ON LOAN
item.description: Barnsley Football Club can confirm that forward Leo Farrell has joined National League outfit Scunthorpe United on a 28-day youth loan. The 20-year-old will continue his development with the Irons at the Attis Arena, as Andy Butler's side compete at the top end of the division looking for a return to the EFL. Everyone at Oakwell wishes Leo the best of luck for the next month.

item.title: REDS TEAM TO TAKE ON CHAIRBOYS
item.description: Team news is proudly sponsored by Copier Systems Limited. Conor Hourihane has named his starting eleven for this evening's Sky Bet League outing against Wycombe Wanderers. The Reds make two changes from Saturday's win over Leyton Orient, with Nathanael Ogbeta and Scott Banks coming into the eleven in place of Corey O'Keeffe and Patrick Kelly.

item.title: CONOR HOURIHANE | POST-WYCOMBE WANDERERS
item.description: Conor Hourihane spoke to iFollow Barnsley after his side fell to a narrow defeat against Wycombe Wanderers in Sky Bet League One at Oakwell on Tuesday night.
